# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.
Email the maintainer directly with:

- a description of the vulnerability,
- steps to reproduce,
- the affected commit or version.

We aim to acknowledge reports within 72 hours and will coordinate a fix
before any public disclosure.

## Scope notes

- Automated secret scanning runs on every push via the gitleaks workflow.
- Dependency vulnerabilities are tracked via Dependabot alerts and fixed
  on a critical/high-first basis.

## What not to report

- Reports generated by automated scanners without a demonstrated exploit path.
- Issues in third-party dependencies without an upgrade path (report those upstream).
